g4_parity.function_relationship: The current historical-to-modern registry identifies the existing V550 recursion and F6 partially identified bounds that were missed by recent decisions; this governance tool is not a new statistical or discovery engine.

function.inputs: User proposal or commission, existing front-door law, exact current source code, G4 parity records and named active PR heads
function.operation: Before choosing or writing code, verify a committed bounded function-to-owner-to-first-consumer crosswalk and its source identities; refuse undocumented novelty and source drift.
function.outputs: Fail-closed checked prebuild decision receipt and visible CI refusal/repair for unexamined new implementation paths
function.first_consumer: The existing PROGRAMMA/MCR commissioning and GitHub PR receiving process, plus every originating OpenCode agent via root AGENTS.md.
function.real_gap: Existing Oct 19 law, G4 inventory and MCR/OATH CI exist, but none of the inspected CI/entrypoints requires an independently inspectable function-reuse decision BEFORE code is first committed.

existing_candidates.difference: Oath presence checks no actual owner/capability comparison
Existing MCR validates commission format and evidence contracts but not source-function reuse

existing_candidates.needle: Reject invalid new or revised copy-paste commissions
existing_candidates.difference: CI is scoped to canonical checks; no across-PR per-implementation function/capability decision validation

search_scope.current_code: Exact protected HEAD, root AGENTS.md, MCR validator, HQ oath checker and existing CI
search_scope.historical_and_g4: Direct G4 FUNCTION_PARITY and 2026-10-19 adopted missing-function law
search_scope.active_development: Inspected #1223 latest composite plus #1207/#1219 previous source owners; prior audit exact SHA 429cfc5f47e04a82302860f6f33ad48e53daf45d
search_scope.uninspected: Unconnected private machines and Library branches not accessible to GitHub; no global absence proof

active_pr_heads.head: 429cfc5f47e04a82302860f6f33ad48e53daf45d
active_pr_heads.relevance: Observed unexamined existing-owner duplication triggering present repair

first_consumer.needle: Reject invalid new or revised copy-paste commissions
first_consumer.expected_effect: A new independent pull-request check and mandatory predesign command extend, rather than replace, existing protected receiving.

positive_proof: New code commit must have a prior committed reuse receipt; current owner symbols/blobs and G4 IDs must resolve; stale protected cut or declared active PR head must fail; newly changed production code/commission without a preceding decision receipt must fail.
negative_proof: Same-commit card-and-code, absent G4 or owner symbol, wrong owner blob, false accepted novelty without missing delta, stale active branch and missing first consumer must all fail.
